reference_versions.provenance: User-provided dashboard screenshot; reference source from the same date. These are reference values, not a live connection report.

condition_fields.t: condition for a comparison node, including event/trigger comparisons; group for a nested group
condition_fields.co: Exact comparison key from live db.comparisons.conditions or db.comparisons.triggers
condition_fields.ro: First typed right operand, if required by the comparison
condition_fields.ro2: Second typed right operand, if required
condition_fields.to: Typed duration/time-offset operand, when the comparison uses it
condition_fields.sm: Subscription method; preserve the existing choice, commonly auto
condition_fields.ts: Statements for a true condition result
condition_fields.fs: Statements for a false condition result

comparison_examples.stays: Timed trigger; supply the required right operand and to duration
comparison_examples.is_greater_than: Numeric state comparison; do not substitute invented gt or comparison keys

engine_fields.s: Engine subscription marker when present on a condition

usage: Call webcore_status before editing conditions and use its live webcore_version and webcore_he_version; plugin_version identifies this plugin, not webCoRE.
Inspect live inventory, language DB comparison definitions and an existing piston. Missing or different live versions require inspecting that hub's format before using this reference.
Comparison p and t metadata determine right-operand and duration requirements; examples are fragments, not ready-to-apply pistons.
Replace the device placeholder with an authorized ID, check attribute types and allowed values, and preserve existing subscription/grouping/timing policies.
Never invent a t=trigger node, descriptive condition wrapper fields, or engine-generated classifications. Keep the native body format and existing prepare/apply/read-back safeguards.

Inspect language_compatibility from lookup, preparation and apply. A first observation or matching versions/hash does not verify this pinned format. Review live native conditions and current definitions when reference_requires_review is true, including changes with unchanged HE labels or unavailable tracking. Pending warnings persist for this source revision; the guide is never rewritten automatically.

Native c/e operands, including notification parameters, normally require exp. Direct time/date/datetime constants use c. Follow expression_operands and correct reported validation paths before upload; validation does not prove notification delivery.

expression_operands.required: Parsed exp object with native expression structure, not just editable c/e text.
expression_operands.empty_text: A native expression with i: [] is valid; it is not a missing exp tree.
expression_operands.validation: Preparation and apply reject missing trees, parser errors and malformed nodes in native operand positions. This is structural validation, not expression execution or a complete parser.
expression_operands.editing: Preserve verified native trees. Obtain freshly parsed metadata from the webCoRE editor for interpolated or calculated messages; do not retain an old tree after changing c/e text.
